contributions.detail: *** THE DeBRY BASIS TRAP RECURS ON THIS FILING - CONFIRMED AT THE PAGE, NOT ASSUMED. *** The two printed anchors on Schedule A have DIFFERENT SCOPES. 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' = $7,090.00, which equals Summary Column A (the PERIOD figure). 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' = $64,793.50, which equals Summary Column B (the CYCLE-CUMULATIVE figure) - and this is a ONE-PAGE schedule, so a 'sum of subtotals' can only be the one subtotal; it is not. The 6 transcribed rows sum to $7,090.00 EXACTLY, so the side reconciles against the page subtotal / summary-line-1. Gating on the schedule grand total would have manufactured a false $57,703.50 delta. In-kind IS included in the page subtotal here: the $3,690.00 row the filer marked '(in kind)' is needed to reach $7,090.00, so no schedule-total-vs-summary-gap arises.

expenditures.detail: Same inversion on Schedule B, verified independently at the page. 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' = $5,252.66 = Summary Column A (period). 'TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' = $25,228.58 = Summary Column B (cycle-cumulative). The single transcribed row is $5,252.66, matching the page subtotal / summary-line-2 EXACTLY. Gating on the schedule grand total would have manufactured a false $19,975.92 delta.
